When the causative suffix -a is suffixed to the verb stem with /ə/, the vowel in the verb root copies the vowel of the suffix and changed into -a. Thus, there is a harmonic assimilation moving backward to affect the preceding syllable.5 This is further illustrated in (10.5.1).
